description_en: Calls ListCampaigns to obtain the list of predictive dialing campaigns under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListCampaigns获取指定实例下的预测式外呼活动列表
name: ListCampaigns

parameters.help_en: Filters campaigns by predictive dialing campaign state. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 按预测式外呼活动状态过滤，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: Filters campaigns by predictive dialing campaign name. Fuzzy match is not supported. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which indicates no filtering
parameters.help_zh: 按预测式外呼活动名称过滤，不支持模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，表示不过滤
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The planned start time of the campaign. This parameter is optional. By default, all time ranges are queried
parameters.help_zh: 外呼活动计划开始时间，非必填，默认查询所有时间范围
parameters.name: planed_start_time_from

parameters.help_en: The planned end time of the campaign. This parameter is optional. By default, all time ranges are queried
parameters.help_zh: 外呼活动计划结束时间，非必填，默认查询所有时间范围
parameters.name: planed_start_time_to

parameters.help_en: The actual start time of the campaign. This parameter is optional. By default, all time ranges are queried
parameters.help_zh: 外呼活动实际开始时间，非必填，默认查询所有时间范围
parameters.name: actual_start_time_from

parameters.help_en: The actual end time of the campaign. This parameter is optional. By default, all time ranges are queried
parameters.help_zh: 外呼活动实际结束时间，非必填，默认查询所有时间范围
parameters.name: actual_start_time_to

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters campaigns by skill group ID. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which indicates no filtering
parameters.help_zh: 按技能组ID过滤，非必填，默认为空，表示不过滤
parameters.name: queue_id

List.description_en: The list of predictive dialing campaigns

ActualEndTime.description_en: The actual end time of the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ActualEndTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动实际结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

ActualStartTime.description_en: The actual start time of the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ActualStartTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动实际开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

CampaignId.description_en: The ID of the predictive dialing campaign

CasesAborted.description_en: The number of aborted cases in the predictive dialing campaign. An aborted case indicates that the call to the contact was canceled
CasesAborted.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的止呼数量，止呼指取消呼叫联系人

CasesConnected.description_en: The number of connected cases in the predictive dialing campaign
CasesConnected.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的接通数量

CasesUncompleted.description_en: The number of uncompleted cases in the predictive dialing campaign. An uncompleted case indicates that the call was not connected and the maximum number of retry attempts was not reached
CasesUncompleted.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的未完成数量，未完成指未接通且未达到最大重试次数

CompletionRate.description_en: The completion rate. This parameter is deprecated. You can calculate the completion rate by using the formula (TotalCases - CasesUnCompleted) / TotalCases
CompletionRate.description_zh: 完成率，参数已废弃，可以使用(TotalCases-CasesUnCompleted) / TotalCases计算得出

ContactFlowId.description_en: The ID of the IVR contact flow associated with the phone number

MaxAttemptCount.description_en: The maximum number of attempts for the predictive dialing campaign. This value specifies the maximum number of redial attempts when a call to a number fails
MaxAttemptCount.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的最大尝试次数，表示当活动的号码呼叫失败时，最多重呼几次

MinAttemptInterval.description_en: The minimum redial interval for the predictive dialing campaign. This value specifies the minimum interval between redial attempts after a failure. Unit: seconds
MinAttemptInterval.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的最小重呼间隔，表示失败重呼时的最小间隔，单位秒

Name.description_en: The name of the predictive dialing campaign

PlanedEndTime.description_en: The planned end time of the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
PlanedEndTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动计划结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

PlanedStartTime.description_en: The planned start time of the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
PlanedStartTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动计划开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

QueueId.description_en: The ID of the associated skill group

QueueName.description_en: The name of the skill group

Simulation.description_en: Indicates whether the campaign is a simulated campaign

State.description_en: The state of the predictive dialing campaign

StrategyParameters.description_en: The strategy parameters of the predictive dialing campaign. Example for the PID strategy: {"abandonRate":"5","historicalConnectedRate":"35"}. Example for the PACING strategy: {"ratio":1}. abandonRate specifies the expected call abandon rate. historicalConnectedRate specifies the historical reference connection rate. ratio specifies the fixed dialing ratio
StrategyParameters.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的策略参数，PID策略下的格式参数示例：{"abandonRate":"5","historicalConnectedRate":"35"}，PACING策略下的格式参数示例：{"ratio":1}。abandonRate表示期望呼损率，historicalConnectedRate表示历史参考接通率，ratio表示固定外呼比例

StrategyType.description_en: The strategy mode of the predictive dialing campaign
StrategyType.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的策略模式

TotalCases.description_en: The total number of phone numbers

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100

PageSize.description_en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
